title: 曼城十年虚增9亿：阿布扎比赞助绕规则，英超最重可判降级？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The biggest finding here is at Manchester City, artificially boosted its financial results by more than 900 million pounds.
segments.zh: 最大的发现是曼城人为夸大了超过9亿英镑的财务业绩。

segments.en: Walk us through in very simple terms what the club did.
segments.zh: 用简单的话说说俱乐部做了什么。

segments.en: It was overstating revenues and it was understating expenses to what end?
segments.zh: 高估收入、低估支出，目的是什么？

segments.en: So the rules at the time were that you cannot lose over a certain amount of money over a three year rolling period.
segments.zh: 当时的规则是，三年滚动期内亏损不能超过一定金额。

segments.en: And the aim of these rules was to stop football clubs going bankrupt, to stop people, and new owners coming into a club, spending all their money on a star striker, or ten,
segments.zh: 这些规则旨在防止足球俱乐部破产，阻止新老板花大钱买球星，

segments.en: you know, messing up the system, messing up the club, club doesn't win the thing, losing lots of money, threatens to go bankrupt the only leaves, right?
segments.zh: 搞乱体系、搞乱俱乐部，俱乐部没赢球、亏钱、面临破产。

segments.en: So, it managed to go around this by being sponsored by companies from Abu Dhabi,
segments.zh: 所以，它通过阿布扎比公司的赞助绕过了规则，

segments.en: and then those sponsorships were essentially topped up by hundreds of millions over years and years.
segments.zh: 这些赞助多年来被额外注入了数亿资金。

segments.en: And so every other club was trying to stick to these rules and sometimes failing, right?
segments.zh: 其他俱乐部都试图遵守规则，有时也失败，对吧？

segments.en: But no one was cheating to this extent, as you said, it's 900 million over the course of ten years or so.
segments.zh: 但没人作弊到这种程度，如你所说，十年间9亿。

segments.en: That's a huge amount of money you can spend on extra players. Charles, let's talk punishment.
segments.zh: 这笔钱足以引进更多球员。查尔斯，我们来谈谈处罚。

segments.en: What could the Premier League do to punish this club? The biggest thing that it can do really is to relegate Manchester City.
segments.zh: 英超能如何处罚这家俱乐部？最严厉的莫过于将曼城降级。
